title: Several owned things: Nämä ovat …
summary: Drop plural -t before the owner ending; use Nämä ovat for several things.
targetSkills: Plural possessed nouns in ownership sentences
objectives: Drop plural -t before the owner ending; use Nämä ovat for several things.
Apply this rule with the supporting forms shown.

sections.title: How the pattern works
paragraphs: For these regular nouns, ordinary nominative plurals end in -t: pallo (“ball”) → pallot (“balls”). Before a possessive ending that -t disappears.
pallot + -mme becomes pallomme (“our balls”). Use Nämä ovat (“These are”) for several things.
Tämä on meidän pallomme names one ball; Nämä ovat meidän pallomme names several balls. The possessed noun looks the same here; the demonstrative and verb reveal object number.
The Focused tasks supply the owner ending and noun plural so dropping -t is the new operation. This same-form rule is bounded to the regular nominative forms here, not every Finnish noun case.
keyPoints: Drop plural -t before the owner ending; use Nämä ovat for several things.

commonMistakes: Do not retain plural -t before the possessive suffix.
Use ovat for several things, regardless of owner number.

parts.formation: Nämä is the plural of tämä: several things.
Use ovat with several things, independently of how many people own them.
Teidän is the personal owner form of te; it selects -nne.
talot (“houses”) loses its plural -t before -nne: talo + -nne = talonne.

answerDiagnostics.explanation: The plural -t disappears before a possessive suffix; use talonne.
This personal owner phrase needs its supplied ending -nne; use talonne.
Keep the supplied ending -nne for teidän; use talonne.

parts.formation: Nämä is the plural of tämä: several things.

omenat (“apples”) loses its plural -t before -nsa: omena + -nsa = omenansa.

answerDiagnostics.explanation: Drop the noun’s plural -t before -nsa: use omenansa.
Keep the possessive ending -nsa even when the owner pronoun is present or omitted.
Heidän needs -nsa; changing the ending changes the owner.
These are several things: Nämä needs ovat, regardless of the number of owners.
